text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Making use of her darkness switch,<n>Shinko Windy
performs well, and<n>finishes without getting the urge
to<n>bite anyone. Even the spectators are<n>beginning to
see her in a different<n>light.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We set her next race as the February<n>Stakes—a G1
race that Biko Pegasus<n>announces she'll also be
entering.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Biko Pegasus's heroic nature<n>ensures that she
can't simply stand<n>by while the world at large
refuses to<n>acknowledge Shinko Windy's talent.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
By having a fierce showdown, they<n>seem set to
change the way the<n>world perceives Shinko Windy.
